name: Jing'an Qu Qi An
source:
Jing'an District is a peaceful place, but sometimes some interesting cases will happen. The cases here are not all so bloody. But it also brings us a lot of reflection and insight. You will play a young policeman in Jing'an District. Go through and solve these cases with your partner. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497700/Jing_an_District_Copstories/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
景安区是个平静的地方，偶尔也会发生一些有趣的案件。这里的案件并非个个血腥，却同样能带给我们许多思考与感悟。你将扮演景安区的一名年轻警察，与搭档一同经历并侦破这些案件。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497700/Jing_an_District_Copstories/]Steam[/url]]
